source_row.rationale: Healthcare facilities typically respond to drug shortages with a structured management protocol, which may include identifying and using appropriate alternative medications, prioritizing remaining supply for the most critical uses, and providing clear staff education about any resulting changes to reduce the risk of errors during the transition.
source_row.source_detail: Shortage management includes therapeutic alternatives, conservation/prioritization strategies and communication; current resource center, accessed 2026-08-14.
source_row.stem: A hospital pharmacy notifies nursing staff of a national shortage of a commonly used medication, and a nurse assumes this means the medication will simply be unavailable with no backup plan until the shortage resolves.
